source: Explicit user replies in the current conversation; each narrowing must be recorded in the card.

decisions.TCS-3075: Uniform approximate sampling of planar perfect matchings, arbitrary epsilon in total variation, polylogarithmic parallel time and processors polynomial in input size and inverse epsilon; record narrowing.
decisions.TCS-4193: General-graph randomized LOCAL two-ruling lower bound Omega(sqrt(log n / log log n)), success at least 1-1/n.
decisions.TCS-0836: Quantitative nonadaptive subset tests, uniform random k-set with k=n^c, O(k) tests and success tending to one; retain subsets, not multisets.
decisions.TCS-3381: Leaderless pairwise population protocols, stable consensus under every fair execution, polynomial states in original quantified Presburger formula, without construction-time or convergence-time bound.
decisions.TCS-6767: For every sufficiently large fixed width w, linear-size 3-CNF families with width at most w but unrestricted resolution length Omega(n^(w-c)) for one absolute c.
decisions.TCS-6759: PSPACE-completeness of deciding clause-space-bounded general resolution refutability for unrestricted-width input CNF.
decisions.TCS-6770: Uniform polynomial simulation of unrestricted-coefficient Cutting Planes by proofs with both length and coefficient magnitudes bounded by one polynomial in original input size plus proof length; no memory bound.
decisions.TCS-0398: Uniform deterministic polynomial bit-time algorithm returning an exactly longest Euclidean tour of rational planar points.
decisions.TCS-0969: One-pass randomized factor-two LIS length estimation over length-n sequences from [n], success at least 2/3; optimal bit space up to constants.
decisions.TCS-0993: Factor-two single-pair distance estimation on undirected unweighted arbitrary-order edge streams, probability at least 2/3, O(n polylog n) bit space and O(log n) passes.
decisions.TCS-0834: Optimal degree-distribution query complexity in all four parameters n,m,h,min positive d*N(d), fixed 10-percent bicriteria error, original three oracles, constant-factor matching.
decisions.TCS-0980: Full L-step walk with 1 <= L <= n on an unweighted directed graph; start known before stream; total-variation error at most 1/100; record narrowing.
decisions.TCS-0970: Fast application to sparse vectors at optimal JL output dimension, time (input sparsity + output dimension) times polylogarithm of input dimension; remove separate seed-length objective and record narrowing.
